brief: Continue this fictional note with one short paragraph explaining my preferred alternative and inviting written comments. Return only the continuation, not the existing passage. Preserve the tentative status; do not invent an affiliation or personal history.
source_text: The library has not signed its proposed reading-app contract. I oppose its provision for keeping identifiable reading histories for two years after account closure.
facts: I prefer anonymous aggregate usage totals and reading without creating an account.
Written comments are accepted until June 30.
